context: Request: the firm's most recent Tax matter with a tax indemnity provision in an executed agreement, and the document evidencing it. Rubric: 1001-00006 (Ardent Capital Partners) and its closing-tax-memorandum.docx, plus precision (no other matter asserted as most recent). Runs named 1046-00001 (Helix Bio de-SPAC, T0) and 1036-00005 (Harbor Point JV tax protection agreement, T1 and T2).

runs.failure_point: It opened the matter it needed but not its closing tax memorandum, and named a later-dated joint venture tax protection agreement.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its tax-path listing at [36]-[37] showed the needed matter's closing tax memorandum, but when it opened that matter it read only a tax receivable agreement and a draft indemnity markup and set the matter aside.
first_error.critic_note: Reviews named unopened matters and questioned the later-dated agreement; none named this matter or its closing documents.

other_errors.why: It presents a joint venture's partner tax protection agreement as the most recent Tax-matter tax indemnity (evidence seen at [57]-[80]), although its own reads showed blank signature lines and the reviews questioned the fit.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) Reviews [72] and [82] said the agreement is a partner tax-protection agreement rather than a transaction tax indemnity, with unconfirmed execution; review [121] said to make a signed older matter primary. The agent kept it with a caveat.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way at the answer (a later-dated matter named instead of the needed one), but went off course at different stages. T0 and T1 never opened the needed matter although their searches listed it: T0 followed a review's advice to rank candidates by matter number and restricted its scan and listings to the highest numbers (critic: review-endorsed); T1's listing of that matter was cut off by its own line cap and its next listing skipped every matter below a number cutoff, though one review named the matter and another named the cutoff (surfaced, not opened). T2 did open the matter but read only a tax receivable agreement and a draft markup, leaving out the closing tax memorandum shown in its own listing (listed document not opened), then named a joint venture's tax protection agreement that three reviews questioned. Label notes were ignored in each run (three times in T0, once in T1 and T2).
